comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Obtained as the reward for completion of 19-star Relic 2 from the The Fall of Atlantis Treasure Hunt; also part of the Truth of the Rumours (No.6) Memorial Album.

The recipe(s) this item could've been used for in UWO do not exist on Maris server as of this comment and likely never will, so it has no use beyond filling out the Memorial Album (which does yield a very nice item on completion, at least).

Well, at least now you know. Cheers.
